scope: All TMODULO persons retained; primary_commuting_population selects approved geographic/age/active-work domain. Candidate outcome mappings await scientific review.

person_id.transformation: Exact string alias; unique and nonempty required

state.transformation: Exact string; primary domain 09/15; staging preserves other states

sex.missing: unknown code becomes null and is counted

age.transformation: Exact integer age 00..96; 97 is retained as lower bound 97+; 98/99 are unknown, not ages
age.missing: null for special/invalid/empty; outside primary domain

active_worker.transformation: P5_1 == 1 OR P5_2 in 1..6; exact approved rule
active_worker.missing: unrecognized employment codes fail validation rather than silently redefine eligibility

employment_reference_week_absent.transformation: P5_2 == 7; retained but excluded from primary_commuting_population

work_modality.missing: null for skips, with work_modality_status; never infer in-person for other occupations

commute_weekday_min.transformation: 60*hours+minutes for valid observed pair; zero for confirmed virtual-only skip; includes trips for all jobs
commute_weekday_min.missing: other skips remain null: P5_2=7, P5_2=8, total weekly work <60min; unexplained or partial blanks unresolved; special/invalid/conflicting pairs null

commute_structural_zero.transformation: true only for blank time pair on approved active virtual-only branch
commute_structural_zero.missing: false otherwise; reported zero remains observed

sleep_weekday_min.missing: 99 in either field means No sabe: null; preserve pair and special_code status

selfcare_weekday_min.transformation: 60*hours+minutes for exclusive personal hygiene/grooming; excludes eating, sleep, health care and resting
selfcare_weekday_min.missing: special/invalid/unresolved pairs null; no blanket zero
selfcare_weekday_min.approval: candidate narrow hygiene definition; not the broad official personal-care aggregate

family_weekday_min.transformation: 60*hours+minutes for exclusive conversation with household members, in person or virtual; P6_21_1=2 and blank pair gives flagged structural zero
family_weekday_min.missing: P6_21_1=1 with blanks unresolved; No with reported time is a conflict; special/invalid null
family_weekday_min.approval: candidate household-conversation definition, not all family/friend socializing

work_weekday_min.transformation: Sum required weekday branches: P5_7=1 first, =2 second, =3 both. P5_5=2..6 with P5_7 blank: first branch holds all work without modality distinction. Includes all jobs and meal time during work; excludes home-work commuting
work_weekday_min.missing: inactive/absent structural null; unused branches remain structural blanks, not generic zeros; required missing component makes sum null
work_weekday_min.evidence: questionnaire p12; DDI V3525..V3530 interview instructions

has_child_u15.transformation: Any known roster age <15 per household, then validated many-to-one join
has_child_u15.missing: true if known child; null if none known and any unknown age; otherwise false

has_minor_u18.transformation: Any known roster age <18 per household, then validated many-to-one join
has_minor_u18.missing: true if known minor; null if none known and any unknown age; otherwise false

household_size.transformation: Number of unique roster persons per household; all ages; no exclusions; duplicate person IDs fail

stratum.transformation: Exact string alias, retaining leading zeros

cluster.transformation: Exact string alias, retaining leading zeros

leisure_candidates_not_built.activity: prayer/meditation/rest; classified under official personal care
